The shared lowest common ancestor of Busulfan and Azathioprine, both classified as Organosulfur Compounds, suggests a possible biochemical pathway where Busulfan's effects are mediated through Azathioprine. The relationship between Busulfan and Gstm1 is thus inferred through a pathway involving Cytotoxic Chemotherapeutic Agents and Organosulfur Compounds, with the exact nature of the interaction between Busulfan and Gstm1 remaining uncertain.
